China travel guide for Arab families and traders

How to plan a first trip to China: the main cities, sample itineraries, the best season, costs, visa and app essentials, with links to our detailed English guides. Start with the China overview and the best things to do in China 2026.

Where to go

  • Beijing: the Great Wall at Mutianyu, the Forbidden City, the Summer Palace, the pandas at Beijing Zoo and Universal Beijing Resort for families.
  • Shanghai: the Bund, Shanghai Tower, Disneyland and the water town of Zhujiajiao. See the Shanghai guide for Arab tourists and traders.
  • Xi'an: the Terracotta Army, the city wall by bicycle and the Muslim Quarter's halal street food.
  • Guangzhou and Yiwu: the trade capitals, Canton Fair and the world's largest small-commodities market. See tourism in Guangzhou and the Yiwu guide for Arab traders.

Compare cities in the 8 best Chinese cities for tourism and trade and top tourist cities in China.

Sample itineraries

  • 7 days: Beijing (4) → high-speed train → Shanghai (3).
  • 10 days: Beijing (4) → Xi'an (2) → Shanghai (4), the classic family route.
  • Trade trip, 6–8 days: Guangzhou (Canton Fair or markets) → Yiwu → Shanghai or Shenzhen for factory visits. See the Canton Fair 2026 guide, the best China trade fairs 2026 and how to visit factories in China.

Ready-made options are on travel programs in China.

Best time to visit

April to May and September to October offer mild weather and clear skies in all the main cities. Avoid Chinese New Year (late January to mid-February), the Golden Week of 1–7 October and the first days of May, when hundreds of millions travel domestically. Summer is hot, humid and crowded; winter is cold in Beijing but cheap, and mild in Guangzhou.

What a trip costs

For a family of four on a 10-day private program with 4-star hotels, trains, tickets and an Arabic-speaking guide, expect roughly 5,000–7,000 USD excluding international flights. Full details in tourism costs in China.

Visa, apps and halal food

  • Check the latest visa-free and transit rules for your nationality, or apply at the Chinese embassy four weeks before travel; see the Chinese visa guide 2026.
  • Install Alipay and WeChat Pay linked to an international card before arrival; cash and foreign cards are rarely accepted. See essential China travel apps.
  • Arrange an eSIM or VPN before you land to keep WhatsApp, Google Maps and Gmail working; see VPN in China 2026.
  • Halal restaurants (look for the green 清真 sign) exist in every city; see halal food in China and China travel tips.

Frequently asked questions

Is China safe for families?
Yes. Crime rates are very low and the cities are clean and well policed; the main challenge is language, which the guide solves.

Do guides speak Arabic?
Yes. Arcadia provides Arabic-speaking escorts in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou and Yiwu, plus English-speaking guides.

Can we combine tourism and sourcing in one trip?
Yes. Many of our clients spend four days in Beijing and Shanghai with the family, then two or three days in Guangzhou or Yiwu for business; see China business and sourcing travel.

How far in advance should we book?
Six to eight weeks, and earlier for Canton Fair dates when Guangzhou hotels fill up.

Ready to discover China?

Our team is available to answer your questions and design your perfect trip.
